scope: Frontend only in the existing dirty worktree; no push/merge/deploy. Original backend, financial/domain, auth, journal and storage authority preserved. Narrow read presentation exceptions are classified in ORDERS_PRESENTATION_BOUNDARY.md and RETURNS_PRESENTATION_BOUNDARY.md.
implemented: Order Detail always reads the current record and admits only matching current store/record/context/generation. Current denials and malformed/foreign records cannot reappear as saved confirmed content. Existing same-owner offline read remains labelled unconfirmed with commands disabled.

Order Detail refund quantities, line edits and fulfillment use canonical full-page editors; cancellation and completion references use canonical sheets. Original typed result fields, units, numerical helpers, commands, proofs and journals are retained.

Current-route submit/close guards cover Detail and the existing shared store-retirement wrapper. Exit callbacks cannot pop or submit through the newly current route. Controllers retire after route disposal; dirty Back preserves input.

Detail zero and absent amounts are distinct; full selectable identity and natural line/metadata/total layouts replace clipping. Received timeline and fallback current-state summary are labelled separately. No provider mode is fabricated.

Returns owns current applied server status/page, rows and exact population metadata. Query changes retire the old population, same-query refresh labels prior rows unconfirmed, current denial removes private rows and commands. Generation/disposal guards prevent stale settlement.

Return creation is a full-page editor with original defaults and supported methods. Lost acknowledgement retains one immutable request/key in memory in the open workspace and uses the existing optional SDK key for explicit original retry. No durable persistence or cross-restart guarantee was added.

Return refund references use a short canonical sheet. Existing saved intent, MFA approval, provider reference and command proof/key sequence stay intact. Preparation is owned once before the form opens.
Canonical LetbuyyInlineFeedback extends the existing UI-kit feedback owner for persistent recovery copy. Transient feedback behavior is unchanged.

Filled existing empty badge_widget owner with token-paired LetbuyyStatusBadge/Colors and adopted it in Order Detail. Raw missing risk fields are unavailable, not confirmed zero/low; original risk rules remain unchanged.

Fulfillment now reads the existing authorized provider-mode endpoint on demand and on explicit recheck. It distinguishes reported mode from carrier_booking_available, withholds booking for unavailable/inconsistent status, and keeps manual fulfillment independently usable. Old optional responses cannot grant a newer view. Original shipping command/request defaults and sequence remain unchanged. Existing ProviderModeBadge composes the shared readable status owner; its enum/parser/public constructor remain unchanged.

Latest current Return read denial is now shared through existing service notification across mounted views/forms/captured callbacks. Outage cannot clear it; a successful current read can restore presentation without discarding the original in-memory intent/key. Page freshness binds the exact accepted row-list/read generation; another query or command cannot silently grant stale actions or relabel old rows. Creation correlates the response to the requested canonical UUID order. Original service command/model/journal/persistence bodies remain unchanged.
